PARAM:p_ij.meaning: kill probability of weapon i against target j

PARAM:k_j.meaning: kill-probability threshold required for target j to be considered destroyed

VAR:x_ij.meaning: 1 if weapon i is assigned to target j; 0 otherwise

VAR:y_j.meaning: 1 if target j is considered destroyed; 0 otherwise

DERIVED:S_j(X).meaning: survival probability of target j under assigned weapons

DERIVED:OV_j(X,Y).meaning: overkill penalty for destroyed target j

DERIVED:IK_j(X,Y).meaning: invalid-kill penalty: weapons assigned to an undestroyed target

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: maximize destroyed-target value while penalizing overkill and invalid kill

CON:C1.meaning: each weapon is assigned to at most one target

CON:C2.meaning: target j can be declared destroyed only if its kill threshold is reached

SEMANTIC:unsupported_generic_residual_su.meaning: generic residual survival minimization without y_j destruction decisions

SEMANTIC:unsupported_planted_target_dest.meaning: planted target destruction scheme or heuristic initial solution in public input

algorithm_boundary: logarithmic transformation, TSHHS, SimpleO and MMRBH are solution algorithms; they are not the gold optimization model
